title: philadelphus sericanthus var. kulingensis
intro: Philadelphus sericanthus var. kulingensis, commonly known as Chinese mock orange, is a plant species in the family Hydrangeaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality, making it beneficial for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Chinese mock orange include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant's health benefits include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system.
